ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, April 18, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Ag Production & Processing, Construction Management, Digital & Precision Ag and Energy and the Environment students on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 300 is offered online in the summer and winter terms as well as this fall term. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 10 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 26, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Business Undeclared or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Ag Production & Processing or Construction Management or Digital & Precision Ag or Energy and the Environment major(s) or minor(s).
